newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine barley crop seen up yr/yr - Ag Minister.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine barley crop seen up yr/yr - Ag Minister.

text.p: Ukrainian Deputy Prime Minister in charge of agriculture Mykhailo Zubets said on Thursday that Ukraine would have a "much better" barley crop this year.

"It will be much bigger than last year," Zubets, who is also the Agriculture Minister, told Reuters. He did not say exactly how many tonnes Ukraine expected to harvest and did not comment on potential exports.
Last year's barley harvest was 5.7 million tonnes.
Officials have hinted at barley exports from Ukraine's overall grain crop, forecast at 35 million tonnes this year against 24.5 million tonnes from last year's drought-blighted output.
Zubets said summer barley heads were forming well but that recent heavy rains in harvest areas could have a negative impact on overall figures.
The minister said Ukraine had planted small amounts of winter barley last year, for a total of 200,000 hectares. --Irene Marushko, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 244-9150
